CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  March 4, 2019-6:25 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

0  SPECIAL MEETING

  OPENING:  Mayor Tornek called the special meeting to order. at 6:25 p.m.
  (Absent: None)

  ORDINANCES-ADOPTED  Adopt "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PASADENA
  AMENDING  CHAPTER  5.45  (SEXUALLY ORIENTED
  BUSINESSES) OF THE PASADENA MUNICIPAL CODE"
  (Introduced by Councilmember Gordo) (Ordinance No. 7340)_

  The above ordinance was adopted by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Gordo, Hampton, Madison,
  Masuda, McAustin, Wilson, Vice Mayor Kennedy,
  Mayor T ornek
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 6:27 p.m.
